newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Grain 2.13 pct up on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Grain 2.13 pct up on retail buying.

text.p: Shares of Ceylon grain Elevators Ltd rose 2.13 percent or 50 cents to 24 rupees on retail buying in early Tuesday trade, brokers said.
"Renewed buying has set in after the correction, by retailers who favour the share due to its low value," said a broker.
Grain Elevators fell to 23.50 rupees from about 25 in the correction which began on April 23, following a market rally which saw the Colombo all-share index rise more than 15 percent, he said.
The company mills animal feed and grows day-old chicks for the domestic market. It is a unit of Prima Ltd of Singapore.
